name: Poison Grounds
description: The Stone Fangs clan are experts in poisons and herbalism. They extract the substance from giant scorpions, giant snakes, and basilisks. Some refined poisons are extracted from the tails of imprisoned young purple worms and from green dragons. Agents of the clan are consistently hiring adventurers to hunt these creatures and bring them alive, paying some considerable amount of gold, even though the funds often come from pillaging. On other occasions, a beast might escape, causing destruction in the area.
